text:
Sam: Heads up — noticed increased PCIe AER errors and NVLink link_flap warnings on rack-r104-gpu3 during a batch job run.
Priya: saw job latencies spike, can you paste dmesg snippet?
Sam: paste logs:
```
[2026-05-12T02:01:23Z] nvrm: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 62, PID 2345
[2026-05-12T02:01:23Z] pcie_bus_error: AER: Multiple Corrected errors, Severity: Corrected
[2026-05-12T02:02:01Z] nvlink: nvlink_link_wait: link 1 flapping
```
Mateo: that Xid 62 is often memory/driver related, could be a flaky card. any ECC correctable counts rising?
Sam: nvidia-smi -q -d ECC shows CorrectableECC=1234 (up from 12 last hour).
Priya: who owns that host? Jen from infra owns r104 right?
Jen: yep, oncall for r104. I'm running remote health checks now. Starting memtest and bus scan.
infra-bot: incident created INC-2026-0427, severity P2 — GPU link flaps causing perf degradation in eu-west-1.
Jen: memtest started, also queued a node drain for current batch jobs. Recommended: cordon + drain for r104-gpu3.
Sam: still seeing pcie resets: `pcieport 0000:65:00.0: AER: Multiple Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error` — which aligns with NVLink failing.
Priya: hold on draining entire rack until we confirm spare GPUs. how many spares in eu-west-1 pool?
Mateo: spare inventory shows 4 spare GPUs in rack-r107 and 2 in the spare pool. Capacity drop if we evict r104: ~8% throughput for current customers.
Jen: plan: cordon node, live-migrate two critical jobs to r107, drain, then attempt power-cycle + reseat GPU. If errors persist open RMA.
Sam: can we avoid full reseat and try soft reset first? ipmitool chassis power cycle -> then `nvidia-smi -r` and `echo 1 > /sys/bus/pci/rescan`.
Priya: agreed, try soft reset first. Jen, please run the steps and paste outcomes.
Jen: running soft reset now.
Jen: soft reset logs:
```
# nvidia-smi -r
GPU reset succeeded
# dmesg | tail -n 40
[2026-05-12T02:15:02Z] nvlink: link 1 recovered
[2026-05-12T02:15:02Z] pcie: link training successful
```
Sam: good sign, ECC counts stopped increasing for now.
Priya: but we still saw 'uncorrected' earlier — keep this node cordoned for 6h and monitor.
Mateo: propose adding AER/NVLink histogram alert to infra metrics: trigger at >5 corrected/sec or any uncorrected.
Jen: added temporary alert and increased collection frequency for that node.
ops-bot: scheduled job relocation: 4 containers moved from r104-gpu3 to r107-gpu1.
Sam: vendor (NVIDIA partner) reached out, asking for logs and the GPU serial. I've uploaded logs and ECC counters to the ticket.
Priya: action items: 1) Keep node cordoned 6h (Jen) 2) Run overnight memtest and vendor RMA if failures persist (Jen) 3) Add NVLink/AER threshold alerts (Mateo) 4) Notify affected customers and document perf impact (Sam)
Jen: noted, memtest running and will update in the morning. will open RMA if memtest fails.
Priya: thumbs up. small follow-up: check if this is isolated to eu-west-1 or we have similar noise in us-west.
Mateo: scanned cluster logs — minor corrected AERs across multiple regions but only r104 had uncorrected count >0. Flagged for review.
Sam: closing loop for now — keeping thread open until end of cordon window. :white_check_mark:
